#🇬🇧
This competition will assign the title of *2026 national champion*  for the event 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.
Registration and locations can be found [here](https://fm.danskspeedcubingforening.dk/competitions/FMCItaly2026)

The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for FMC Italy 2026 as the number of spots for national title contenders is quite limited.
